estimators.binary_rate: x/n with integer x and n
estimators.paired_binary: exact two-sided McNemar using discordant counts b and c
estimators.multiple_comparisons: Holm-Bonferroni independently within each declared four-contrast family
estimators.agreement: Cohen kappa from public n, agreements, and positive marginals
estimators.historical_continuous_metrics: copied only from the self-hashed V1 aggregate; no row-level recomputation claim

denominator_rule: intended_n_equals_terminal_n; failures and exclusions remain explicit and cannot count as defenses
